input.summary: Insert Contractor (Vendor) indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of law, data/confidentiality breach and wilful misconduct
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no Contractor indemnity at all, even though Section 7 is titled "Indemnification of Contractor", so we have added a Contractor indemnity covering third-party IP infringement claims, breach of law, Contractor-caused disclosure of our Confidential Information and wilful misconduct, with standard notice, control and cooperation mechanics. If helpful we can discuss the usual IP exclusions (our modifications, combinations and specifications) and procure/modify/replace/refund remedies as a fallback.

ops.text: (d) Contractor shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Company and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (i) an allegation that the Services or Works infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (ii) Contractor's breach of applicable law; (iii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Company's Confidential Information caused by Contractor; or (iv) Contractor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. Company shall give Contractor prompt written notice of any such claim, Contractor shall have control of the defense and settlement (provided that no settlement imposing any liability or admission on Company shall be made without Company's prior written consent), and Company shall provide reasonable cooperation at Contractor's expense. Contractor's obligations under this Section 7(d) are not subject to the limitations set forth in Sections 7(a), 7(b) and 7(c).
